PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://xi.li.nus.edu/schemas/2021/ref.owl#>
SELECT ?p ?ts WHERE {
  ?p brick:hasName ?name .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?name), "hwpump01"))
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}
